fusions.name: Roused Too Early
fusions.desc: A sweep that deals 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Winter Reserves
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 10 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds and slows it by 30% for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Short Hibernation
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Waking Hunger
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
